name: Bun rieu
summary: Bún riêu is a crab and tomato noodle soup. Vietnam Tourism describes slippery rice noodles, fresh crab, tofu, and stewed tomatoes in an acidic broth, with clusters of minced crab, ground pork, and egg.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s dish list sends the bowl to Hai Bà Trưng in Hanoi.
taste: The dish list calls the soup acidic, from crab and tomato.
howToEat: The crab shell is pounded and strained for the broth. Minced crab, ground pork, and egg form the clusters in the bowl, with tofu and stewed tomatoes.
where: Bún Riêu Cua Thanh Hồng, 42 Hòa Mã, Ngô Thì Nhậm, Hai Bà Trưng. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun rieu — Hanoi crab noodle soup
seoDescription: Bún riêu in Hanoi is crab and tomato with rice noodles, tofu, and egg-and-pork crab clusters. Vietnam Tourism names 42 Hòa Mã.
